jobs_schedule_end_needs_start.name: jobs_schedule_end_needs_start

signature_refusals_resolution_complete.name: signature_refusals_resolution_complete
signature_refusals_resolution_complete.value:
("signature_refusals"."resolved_at" is null and "signature_refusals"."resolution" is null and "signature_refusals"."resolved_by" is null)
          or ("signature_refusals"."resolved_at" is not null and "signature_refusals"."resolution" is not null and "signature_refusals"."resolved_by" is not null)

checklist_questions_range_ordered.name: checklist_questions_range_ordered

checklist_questions_range_only_for_measu.name: checklist_questions_range_only_for_measurement
checklist_questions_range_only_for_measu.value:
"checklist_questions"."response_type" = 'measurement'
          or ("checklist_questions"."expected_min" is null and "checklist_questions"."expected_max" is null)

availability_timed_needs_times.name: availability_timed_needs_times
availability_timed_needs_times.value: "availability"."all_day" or ("availability"."start_time" is not null and "availability"."end_time" is not null)
